payload.core_mechanism_summary: 1D DP from right to left: dp[i] = sum_{j > i+a[i]} dp[j] * C(j-i-1, a[i]), using precomputed factorials and modular inverses for combinations.
payload.rationale: The DP state is index i (1D), but transitions rely heavily on combinatorial coefficients for selecting elements, characteristic of dp_counting_combinatorics.
